decision.explanation: The question asks for the founding date of 'Christ Lutheran Church'. The sources describe four distinct entities with similar names, each with a specific founding date: 1) 'Christ Evangelical Lutheran Church' in Milwaukee (D1S3/D2S3) has conflicting records stating 1884 and 1920 respectively; 2) 'Christ Lutheran Church, Narsapur' (D3S6) states it was started in 1929; 3) 'Christ Lutheran Church (Ellenville, New York)' (D4S2/D5S2/D6S1) states it was built/founded in 1862. As these are distinct valid referents (different locations and full names), all four dates are retained as complementary answers.
